summary: Dated October 3, 2023, this Local Health and Wellness piece surveys creative mental health awareness campaigns: viral hashtags, influencers, a chatbot, theater, school empathy programs, culturally responsive outreach, a video game and a culinary initiative. Each is tied to a named leader and launch date, and the piece frames the conversation as an ongoing effort toward destigmatizing mental health.
one_line: A survey of 2023 mental health awareness campaigns using social media, influencers, chatbots, theater, schools, cultural outreach, gaming and cooking.
key_facts: Alicia Townsend, a digital strategist and mental health advocate, launched the #MindMattersVibe hashtag campaign on September 7, 2023.
Jackson Blaire has 2 million Instagram followers and Mia Song is a TikTok creator; both act as mental health advocates.
Mia Song shared a piece interpreting the turbulence of anxiety on October 12, 2023, earning over 5 million views.
Startup MindBuddy launched a mental health chatbot named "Ava" on September 15, 2023, offering round-the-clock emotional support.
MindBuddy CEO Ethan Nguyen said a chatbot can't replace therapy but can be the first step for someone hesitant to seek help.
The 'Mind Play' Festival, conceived by playwright Susan Warner, was unveiled on September 21, 2023; its showstopper was a musical titled "Inside Out".
Dr. Carol Jennings spearheaded a partnership between public schools and mental health organizations starting September 19, 2023, to integrate empathy-based learning into the curriculum.
Dalia Rodriguez launched the "Voices Unheard" campaign on October 1, 2023, focused on mental health in minority ethnic groups and culturally respectful messaging.
The game "MindQuest", created by Lucas Chen, was released on September 29, 2023, embedding mental health themes in its storyline.
Celebrity chef Renee Ellison initiated "#EatToFeelGreat" on October 5, 2023, linking balanced diet to mental wellness through cooking segments and workshops.
School workshops and assemblies feature guests such as Jackson and Mia.
